decision: Retain the original kernel setting and preceding full-suite reference; this subset does not establish a new suite score
timing_interpretation: Both all-action totals and second-action totals overlap across conditions; faster second actions also occur after returning to the control
causal_limit: Different physical cache states remain despite fixed logical plans, SQL, read bytes and query profiles. This experiment does not establish that the candidate causes a regression or that host-memory optimization is ineffective.
background_compaction: Present in slow and fast samples; occurrence alone is not a root-cause diagnosis
shadow_metadata_reclaim: workingset_nodereclaim increases in the B1 Q10/Q12 first actions; retained as a correlation requiring runtime stacks or an isolated test before causal attribution
investment_decision: Do not expand this kernel knob into a parameter sweep. Prioritize measured reductions in scan/join/aggregate work; retain host allocation and cache behavior as a separate stability investigation.
measurement_limit: PSI full time is a host stall signal within sampled query windows, not independently additive query time. Scan operator durations are task sums.
resource_audit: Shutdown logs still contain CUDA buffer leak messages in both conditions; the final process audit found no retained Spark or GPU compute processes. No leak-free claim is made.
